definition: A junction point on an evolutionary diagram where three or more lines connect directly to a single central spot.
problems: judge: The definition states 'three or more lines connect directly to a single central spot' as a general rule, but the source distinguishes between rooted trees (three or more child subtrees) and unrooted trees (four or more branches). The definition omits the unrooted tree condition and presents the rooted-tree threshold as universal.
